title: Re-verify CivitAI weight licences against the page badge, and settle the redistribution question
description: The v1 API cannot see a model's licence badge; re-check every CivitAI weight and decide what authorises our R2 mirror. MOSTLY DISCHARGED by the MPI-429 sweep 2026-08-03 - badges read for all 22 deps that declare CivitAI, the redistribution question DECIDED (ship as-is, low practical risk), the Krea 2 NSFW weight settled as coyotte/LUSTIFY with credit. What remains: klein-style-chibi and -doodle are still badge-less, and 9 weights whose origin is a bare merge FILENAME were invisible to the sweep and are unchecked - 5 of them ship in v1.0.1. See brief.md.
